scientific_intent.scientific_task: RCB particle-force evaluation using the source CUDA softened, truncated gravitational operator in its direct-interaction limit
scientific_intent.description: The selected program is a HACC/LANL gravitational force-tree test, not halo labeling. It constructs a recursive coordinate bisection tree, builds leaf interaction lists and updates all particle velocities with a tiled GPU pair-force kernel. The named configuration sets opening angle zero and checks the complete actual softened-cutoff force field.
scientific_intent.classification_rationale: Particle gravity with geometric tree/list preparation and pairwise force accumulation. Source name halo-finder does not establish a connected-component or halo-membership operator.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Sum mass_j*(r_j-r_i)/(||r_j-r_i||²+softening²)^(3/2), excluding zero-distance and outside-cutoff pairs; source 4×4 private tiles, full-warp shuffle sums and Float32 atomic updates. Full source C++ RCB construction/traversal remains in every model.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Particle-gravity developers assessing numerical force kernels, tree-to-GPU interfaces, pinned-host memory, CUDA warp features and scientific acceptance gates. This is not a complete cosmological solver, halo catalog, orbital integrator or astrophysical ground-truth validation.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Predeclared component budget abs0.05+rel2e-4 against independent Float64 all-pairs forces; conservation of net force/torque to normalized1e-5. All 20 captures audited: relative L2 error3.999e-8–8.455e-8, maximum used fraction0.106 of the component budget. No uniform relative-error claim near canceled components. Exact initial bits and every dynamic input/metadata byte are checked.

scientific_intent.reference_condition: All scientific GPU and CPU tree/list function bodies remain unchanged. The GPU ignores the supplied Newton/SR ForceLaw and computes a softened cutoff rule; independent one-pair witness proves the mismatch. The named direct-limit operator is explicitly certified, without claiming original N/S model fidelity. Guard/observer/dispatch adapters preserve mapped-host allocation and all mathematical operations.
scientific_intent.input_provenance: First10001 case is byte-identical to original source generation across70,007 Float32 fields (SHA f052addbd248413eec6b3a109e7152eb066b823db61eca9728ecc000a994bbb2). Unique CPU-only IDs tag particle permutations; original test used all-zero IDs.
scientific_intent.boundary_rounding_policy: Open finite particle fixtures, all nonself primary distances within the source cutoff; source zero-distance exclusion and Float32 squared softening/cutoff constants retained. Cutoff-edge/periodic/long-time dynamics are not certified.
